note: Standard Delaware corporation (direct listing) with generic 'any lawful act' purpose clause and no public benefit designation; does have dual-class (Class A/B) supervoting stock for founder control, which is a governance-control feature distinct from a true mission-lock provision. Included for negative/contrast example. No mission exists to protect and founder supervoting stock is control concentration, not mission entrenchment; negative example for the Mission Protection from Ordinary Majority rule.
